senses.sense_definition: The process of creating an imbalance in pressure to draw matter from one place to another.

examples.text: The vacuum cleaner uses strong <w>suction</w> to pull dirt from the carpet.
Certain insects feed through <w>suction</w> by drawing sap directly from plants.

senses.sense_definition: A force that pushes or draws matter into a space of lower pressure.

examples.text: The pump generates enough <w>suction</w> to draw water out of the flooded basement.
A sudden drop in air pressure caused strong <w>suction</w> near the damaged doorway.

senses.sense_definition: A force holding two objects together caused by lower pressure between them than outside.

examples.text: The rubber cup relies on <w>suction</w> to stick securely to the glass window.
Moisture between the two plates broke the <w>suction</w> that held them together.

senses.sense_definition: A medical device used to remove saliva, blood, or other fluids from a patient's mouth or body.

examples.text: The dentist placed a small <w>suction</w> tube in my cheek to clear away excess saliva.
During the surgical procedure, the nurse operated the <w>suction</w> to keep the area clear.

senses.sense_definition: Special influence or personal advantage with people in power.

examples.text: He managed to get the permit quickly because he has some <w>suction</w> at city hall.
Without any political <w>suction</w>, her application was delayed for several months.

traits.comment: informal usage meaning influence or pull

senses.sense_definition: To remove fluids or other contents from a space or patient using a vacuum device.

examples.text: The doctor decided to <w>suction</w> the patient's airway to help him breathe normally.
The dental assistant will <w>suction</w> out excess water before the tooth is filled.

senses.sense_definition: To create a difference in pressure to draw something from one place to another.

examples.text: The industrial machine can <w>suction</w> grains straight into the storage bin.
A special pump is designed to <w>suction</w> sludge from the bottom of the tank.
